acceptance/test_intervals_overlap.py.final:
import pytest

from slotplan.intervals_overlap import intervals_overlap


def test_overlap_cases():
    assert intervals_overlap((540, 600), (570, 630)) is True
    assert intervals_overlap((540, 720), (600, 630)) is True
    assert intervals_overlap((600, 660), (540, 600)) is False


def test_empty_intervals():
    assert intervals_overlap((600, 600), (540, 660)) is False


def test_invalid():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        intervals_overlap((600, 540), (500, 700))

import pytest

from slotplan.utilization import utilization


def test_basic_share():
    assert utilization([(540, 660)], 540, 1020) == 25
    assert utilization([(600, 700), (650, 720)], 540, 1020) == 25
    assert utilization([(400, 600), (1000, 1200)], 540, 1020) == 17


def test_rounding():
    assert utilization([(540, 600)], 540, 1020) == 13
    assert utilization([(540, 840)], 540, 1020) == 63


def test_invalid_window():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        utilization([(540, 600)], 600, 600)


def test_regression_issue_268():
    assert utilization([(540, 600)], 540, 1020) == 12
